QUOTE: **`mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)`** (`:85`) hides a value from the optimizer. In the asm path it is an empty `asm volatile` with `"+r"`; otherwise it XORs with `mbedtls_ct_zero`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the primitive hiding values from the compiler and places it in library/constant_time_impl.h (stated as the home of all primitives, with line :85).
